Where work accumulates

Inside the learning model Cost, persistence & limits

Each present person has one week of time. Work output = time × skill. “Any work” assigns the strongest eligible person first; remaining time may serve another skill. A focused assignment restricts that person’s queue.

Coaching takes 35% of both people’s weeks. At week end, the learner gains 0.65 × 0.35 × the positive skill gap. Working also gives a small gain: 0.015 × time × remaining room to learn. Knowledge persists when coaching ends.

Starting-skill edits change the initial assumption; they do not pretend to be free training. Coaching is the intervention with an explicit capacity cost. If either person is away, or mentor and learner are the same person, coaching is blocked.

Fictional, divisible, independent work. No forgetting, team coordination, hiring, motivation or differences in teaching ability. “60% coverage” is a chosen threshold, not a certification. Baselines share demand and absence. Read the engine.
